opening_line: Saw the Elements Holistic Wellness project, a full site with all the content written from scratch inside a 30 day window.
Saw the graphic designer opening on your careers page.
Saw Timbergon Modular at the top of your portfolio, and construction and trades is the biggest group there. I've designed a few construction sites myself.
Looks like a lot of your clients are healthcare providers and attorneys. I've designed a few sites in both fields myself.
Saw the Riverbend Centre for the Arts redesign, making events easy to find and book is the part that usually gets messy.
Saw the ThinGevity case study, a dark and bold brand made to stand apart from a whole category of look-alike wellness companies.
Saw the Aptum project, a full design system and site overhaul for a cloud company that still keeps a human touch.
Saw the Jimmie Johnson site you built, showing him as an investor and team owner and not only as the seven-time champion.
Saw the Manitoba Ombudsman redesign, pulling buried content up so people can actually find the right information.
Saw the Summer Green Landscaping case study, from no website to the top 3 in 18 months. I've designed a few landscaping sites myself.
Saw the Define Financial redesign for a wealth firm working with retirees. I've designed a few finance sites myself.
Saw the MTN MOD site, the bold black and white look lets their outdoor living projects carry the page.
Saw the Brightline Dealer Advisors site, built around their new headquarters at Hall Park in Frisco. I've designed a few finance and insurance sites myself.
Saw the Poolworks site, "six-figure backyard projects start with a confident click" sums up the job well. I've designed a few construction sites myself.
